hooks.command: CONFIG=.claude/gas-dispatcher.local.json; [ -f "$CONFIG" ] || CONFIG=.claude/gas-dispatcher.json; if [ -f "$CONFIG" ]; then export GAS_DISPATCHER_URL=$(jq -r .url "$CONFIG" 2>/dev/null); export GAS_DISPATCHER_TOKEN=$(jq -r .token "$CONFIG" 2>/dev/null); echo "[gas-dispatcher] loaded from $CONFIG url=${GAS_DISPATCHER_URL:0:40}..."; else echo "[gas-dispatcher] no config found (.claude/gas-dispatcher.json or .local.json). See docs/guide/02-setup.md"; fi
